answer: The ledger admits an agent only with a verifiable delay proof seeded by the hash of the previous registration, so no proof can start before the last one lands. The k-th signup in a rolling 24-hour window needs 2^k seconds of serial hashing: the 10th waits 17 minutes, the 16th 18 hours. Extra cores, hosts joined by a network bridge or a datacenter by a willow-lined canal cannot split or reuse that work. A lone agent pricing jade lots joins fast.
